crossRefs.note: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…

translations.web: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
translations.bsb: He mocks the mockers, but gives grace to the humble.
translations.kjv: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
translations.asv: Surely he scoffeth at the scoffers; But he giveth grace unto the lowly.
